name: Horse Cart
summary: Two-wheeled farm cart with hay and shafts, pulled by a horse by default; set animal to false for the cart alone.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the whole cart and horse at frame 0

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheel and the hooves stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 980 px wide and 420 px tall at s = 1

params.name: animal
params.note: draw the flat-vector/horse pulling the cart; false = the cart alone

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheel turns, cart bounces and the horse walks (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the horse and shafts face left

author: krakujs
